item.description: Omni View Central & South America Brazil may keep a two-real-twelve diesel subsidy thirty more days, shielding bus and truck costs. What You Need to Know: Brazil may keep a two-real-twelve diesel subsidy for thirty more days, a step meant to shield bus and truck costs. Planning Minister Bruno Moretti says the benefit that lapses on Saturday will be extended, while extra fuel relief is costing the federal treasury seven billion reais a month. ...
